div.div: صُولَةٌ مِنْ حِنْطَةٍ and ↓ حِنْطَةٌ مُصَوَّلَةٌ [signify nearly the same, the former meaning A heap of wheat, and the latter wheat in general, cleared from rubbish by means of the implement called مِصْوَلَة or مِصْوَل]: (O, K: [these significations are clearly indicated in the K, and more so in the O, by the context:]) the pl. of صُولَةٌ is صُوَلٌ. (O.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
